entries.label: ZOQ_COLONY_RUINS 1
entries.body:
---- REPORT FROM SURFACE ----

BASED ON OUR FINDINGS, IT SEEMS THESE RUINS WERE ONCE POPULATED BY A CIVILIZATION WHICH CONSISTED OF NOT ONE, BUT THREE CO-EXISTING SPECIES. 

THESE SPECIES SEEM TO HAVE FORMED A VERY CLOSELY-KNIT CULTURE. 

REMAINS OF SMALLISH, ONE-TO-TWO-FEET TALL CREATURES CAN STILL BE FOUND HERE AND THERE IN A SEMI-DECOMPOSED STATE, SUGGESTING THE DESTRUCTION OF THESE CITIES OCCURRED RELATIVELY RECENTLY.

ALL THE SETTLEMENTS WE HAVE ENCOUNTERED METER HIGH RADIOACTIVE READINGS, SUGGESTING BOMBARDMENT WITH FUSION-BASED WEAPONRY. 

WE HAVE NOT FOUND ANYTHING IN THE WAY OF SUCH FIREPOWER AT THE SPORADIC ARTILLERY INSTALLATIONS OR ARMORIES, SO A CIVIL WAR SEEMS VERY UNLIKELY. 

SIR, THESE CITIES HAVE BEEN DEMOLISHED BY AN OUTSIDE FORCE. THERE ARE NO SURVIVORS.

        ---- END OF REPORT ----

entries.translation:
---- 地表報告 ----

根據我們的發現， 這些廢墟過去似乎由一個並 非單一，而是由三個共存物 種組成的文明居住。 

這些物種似乎形成了一個非 常緊密的文化。 

這裡各處仍能找到身高約一 至兩英尺的小型生物遺骸， 處於半腐爛狀態， 顯示這些城市是在相對近期 遭到摧毀。

我們遇到的所有聚落都測得 高度放射性讀數， 顯示曾遭聚變武器砲擊。 

零星的砲兵設施或軍械庫 中，完全找不到具備這種火 力的武器，因此內戰的可能 性極低。 

長官，這些城市是被外來勢 力摧毀的。沒有任何生還 者。

        ---- 報告結束 ----
